sections.title: E. Read the text for questions 21–25.

passage.title: A Sunday with Grandmother
paras: Last Sunday, Kevin and his sister Maya visited their grandmother. They went there by bus and arrived at nine o’clock. First, they helped her water the vegetables. Kevin carried a small watering can, and Maya picked some ripe tomatoes.

After lunch, it started to rain. The children stayed inside and listened to their grandmother’s stories. Before they left, she gave them a basket of tomatoes. Kevin felt happy because he had spent time with his grandmother and helped her in the garden.

stem.html: How did Kevin and Maya travel to their grandmother’s house?
What did the children do first after they arrived?
Why did the children stay inside after lunch?

opts: Because they had to finish their homework.

stem.html: In the sentence “she gave them a basket of tomatoes,” who does “she” refer to?
Which sentence best describes the visit?

opts: The children helped their grandmother and enjoyed being with her.
The children went shopping without their grandmother.
The children spent all day playing outside in the rain.
The children visited their grandmother on a school day.

sections.title: F. Read the text for questions 26–30.

passage.title: Our Class Book Swap
paras: Our class is going to hold a book swap next Wednesday. The activity will take place in Room 6 from 10:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. Each student should bring one storybook in good condition. Write your name on a small card and put it inside the book. Do not write your name on the book itself.

Put your book on the blue table before the activity begins. During the book swap, choose a different book to take home. You do not need to bring any money. After choosing a book, tell a friend why you want to read it.

stem.html: When is the class going to hold the book swap?
What should each student bring?

opts: A storybook with many missing pages.
Some money to buy a storybook.

stem.html: Where should students write their names?

opts: On the cover of the book.
On a small card inside the book.

stem.html: How long will the book swap last?
Why do students not need to bring money?

opts: Because the activity is held every day.
Because they must return every book before lunch.
Because they are going to write a new storybook.
Because they exchange books instead of buying them.
